commands.RUN: Resolve exact scope, eligibility and frozen capability graph; report the lawful packet path without side effects.
commands.CONTINUE: Reconstruct from durable programme/gate/branch/ContinuationRecord evidence; chat state is non-authoritative.
commands.HOLD: Persist a safe ContinuationRecord and stop without side effects.

side_effect_barriers.B1_MUTATION: Revalidate baseline, skill resolution, security envelope, write domain and packet state.
side_effect_barriers.B2_REMOTE_WRITE: Revalidate remote target, permissions, branch identity, authority and credential broker.
side_effect_barriers.B3_INTEGRATION: Revalidate PR head/base, prerequisites in main, tests/QA, scope, warnings and gate class.
side_effect_barriers.B4_AUTHORITY_TRANSITION: Revalidate gate, candidate/evidence identity, authority delta and plan version; operator-reserved deltas stop.
